messages:
anya: New follow-up on air-gapped packaging: propose a tokenized activation pattern so nodes can safely coordinate activation without moving huge trees. Want small on-disk markers, precomputed revert plan, and resumable chunking.

mira: Tokenized activation sounds good. Manifest should include transport_hint, chunk_index, signer_meta, and a revert_plan pointer. Keep manifest compact.

shankar: Streaming signature verification is required. We can HMAC progress logs and keep an incremental verify context per chunk. Pseudo: verify chunk header, append to verifier, write to disk. No full-blob buffering.

leo: Activation flow sketch:
1) Stage payload into /opt/redwood/versions/<id> (streamed).
2) Write activation.token with apply_id and hmac to /var/lib/redwood/activation.token (atomic write+fsync).
3) Symlink swap or symlink token read by nodes to pick version.
4) Run health checks; on success, remove token.

Tj: Implementation notes: use ln -sfn for symlink swap on ext4; for NFS or exotic mounts, fall back to a cluster metadata write (etcd/consul) with the same token. Always fsync after writing token.

devops: Transport options: USB, local rsync agent, or jump-host pull. UI should show step-by-step based on transport_hint. Also include checksum quick-verify step for operators.

mira: Rollback: compute revert_plan at stage time (small JSON listing actions). CLI: `redwood rollback --apply-id <id> --fast` executes revert_plan. Provide dry-run to show steps and disk impact.

shankar: Resume design: manifest lists chunk offsets and sha256 for each chunk. Stage-progress file writes a HMAC-protected line per chunk: `chunk:<id>:offset=<offset>`; on resume, read last good offset and continue.

leo: Failure modes to document: incomplete stage, activation.token present on boot, healthcheck failures, partial service restarts. Provide exact commands to recover, including `cat /var/lib/redwood/activation.token` and `redwood rollback --apply-id <prev_id>`.

sre-oncall: Observability: emit events: apply_id, bytes_staged, verify_latency, activation_duration, health_check_ok. Expose metrics endpoint for staging progress. Alert if activation > 10m.

ops-bot: offline-pkg-lint passed (sha256: d4f1...). CI: 42/42 green.

anya: Action items: tj -> activation script + README (EOW); mira -> manifest schema addendum (3d); shankar -> streaming verify snippet + KMS notes (3d); leo -> failure-mode playbook (EOW). I'll fold this into RFC follow-up unless objections.
